title: SimPOTrans: Self-Adaptation for Offline-to-Simultaneous Speech Translation via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) aims to translate ongoing speech with low latency while preserving translation quality. Recent studies have adopted large language models (LLMs) for SimulST and formulated it as a multi-turn dialogue task for efficient generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, existing dialogue-style SimulST approaches typically rely on specialized training schemes to acquire simultaneous translation behavior, either using synthesized read/write trajectories, which may provide suboptimal training signals, or jointly optimizing translation quality and latency, whose competing objectives may cause optimization instability. In this paper, we introduce SimPOTrans, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style SimulST. translated_title: SimPOTrans：基于强化学习的离线语音翻译到同声语音翻译的自适应方法
translated_abstract: 同声语音翻译（SimulST）旨在以低延迟翻译持续进行的语音，同时保持翻译质量。近期研究采用大语言模型（LLM）进行SimulST，并将其建模为多轮对话任务以实现高效生成，达到了最先进的性能。然而，现有的对话式SimulST方法通常依赖专门的训练方案来习得同声翻译行为：要么使用合成的读/写轨迹，这可能提供次优的训练信号；要么联合优化翻译质量与延迟，而这种相互竞争的目标可能导致优化不稳定。本文提出了SimPOTrans，这是一个强化学习（RL）框架，能够使离线语音翻译模型自适应地转变为对话式SimulST。通过一个简单的两阶段强化学习后训练流程，SimPOTrans对离线模型表现出同声翻译行为给予奖励……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: SimPOTrans提出了一种简单的两阶段强化学习后训练框架，使离线语音翻译模型无需依赖合成轨迹或多目标联合优化即可自适应地获得低延迟的同声语音翻译能力。
en_tdlr: SimPOTrans is a reinforcement learning framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style simultaneous speech translation through a simple two-stage RL post-training pipeline.
